name: idea-vault
description: Cross-project idea capture and review for AI agents. The agent catches ideas mid-conversation ("we should", "next time", "/idea"), confirms before saving, and keeps them in ONE plain-markdown vault with status, priority, checklists and reminder dates. When a session opens it surfaces a short digest of stale and due items — capture without review is a write-only notebook. Pure skill: no hooks, no scripts, no account.
